name: Yukigami Hitoshizuku
source:
Main character lost an important woman 10 years ago, but now she stands right before him with her daughter in this calligraphy classroom by the shrine. A calm mother and a little quiet daughter welcome him, but there are subtle changes in mother's behavior. And feelings gradually get their form...
